context.purpose: Build editable mesh/material scenes, apply declared modifiers and publish verified geometry or CPU/GPU renders. Use prepare-only scenes for repeated camera renders.
context.assumptions: The implementation currently requires Blender 5.2.2. Coordinates are Blender world coordinates; import scale is explicit and rotations follow the declared operation conventions.
context.constraints: One declared scene; bounded image/camera/expansion limits. Mesh imports and CSV inputs use the documented subsets. Remeshing, decimation and Boolean operations can change topology. GPU availability is separate from declarations.
context.inspection: Inspect native mesh bounds/counts, materials, render settings and reopened blend snapshots; use geometry/image panels and retained publication hashes.
context.recovery: UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME needs the configured supported Blender release. Fix material/dependency or input-format faults during planning; retain native logs for modifier/render errors and use a fresh run.

workflow.scope: Declared artifact handoffs with independently verified producer receipts; inspect exact consumer formats and losses.

native-inspection.scope: Registered geometry/field observation hooks; bounded views do not prove physical correctness.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure value functions and expressions resolve for every finite analytic visit before native validation.

lifecycle.timeout: Each native process is bounded by the runner timeout; conformance adds an independent wall-clock watchdog.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation retains partial evidence. Pre-launch cancellation is tested separately from shared in-flight cleanup.
lifecycle.logs: Fresh run directory retains authored input, effective plan, native submissions/stdout/stderr, publications and verification evidence.
lifecycle.verification: Compare independently observed mesh/material/camera state, saved blend reopening and publication membership; decode PNG outputs and reject empty images.

losses: Mesh modifiers can change topology; STL and rendered images do not preserve editable scene semantics.

context.purpose: Render existing verified self-contained Schemaxis blend scenes from new camera directions without rebuilding geometry.
context.assumptions: The implementation currently requires Blender 5.2.2. Coordinates are Blender world coordinates; import scale is explicit and rotations follow the declared operation conventions.
context.constraints: Requires saved Schemaxis node/visibility/camera metadata and packed resources. No arbitrary blend scripts or linked libraries; source changes invalidate verification. CPU rendering is the kit scope.
context.inspection: Inspect native mesh bounds/counts, materials, render settings and reopened blend snapshots; use geometry/image panels and retained publication hashes.
context.recovery: UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME needs the configured supported Blender release. Fix material/dependency or input-format faults during planning; retain native logs for modifier/render errors and use a fresh run.
